en: A black‑and‑white vintage view of a European city street with multi‑story brick townhouses and shop awnings in the foreground. At the end of the gently curving street rises a large neo‑Gothic brick church with multiple steep spires and a very tall, narrow central tower topped by an ornate openwork lantern. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street, giving the scene a bustling urban atmosphere.
